I am farming this maize plot on rented land here in Iringa, so I must be careful with money. The soil in our area still gives a fair yield if the rains come, but I cannot afford much fertilizer since I do not own the land and prices at the agrodealer keep rising. I will buy a little DAP for planting and maybe a small top-dress of urea if I have money after weeding, and I will use the manure from my few goats and chickens. For seed I will buy a hybrid like SC Duma or Pannar because with the short rains we have been getting, local seed gives me too little. My wife and I, with our grown children, will do most of the work ourselves, but for weeding and harvesting I will hire a few neighbors for a few days.
